diagnosis: The first watched closure published every unit reachable from a transient Sweep prefix, including consequences whose immediate propagation reason was a live large clause. Making such live-supported shadow consequences permanent can strengthen the checker formula before a later RAT pivot, even though deleting the transient prefix would not delete that live reason.
fix: The shadow closure records reason ownership. It emits a unit only when the clause that actually propagated it belongs to the retiring prefix; consequences propagated by live binary, live large, or final target clauses remain shadow-only. Kernel and search state stay unchanged.
found_by: Claude-owned AM315 complete fuzz gate, preserved AM296 reproducer leg; Release and Debug deterministically emitted the same rejected proof.
name: sweep-dsr-live-reason-shadow-unit
oracle: Frozen dsr-trim 3b5c7737 with -q -f -c --delete-implied-units rejected AM315 at its later witnessless addition 55 55: an eagerly published proof-only unit -55 made the pivot witness falsify a permanent unit. Frozen Trestle verifies the repaired elaboration.
